I wrote the review to `.social-review.md`. X and Bluesky fail, and LinkedIn passes.

- **X — FAIL:** the copy is 310 characters against the 255 limit. I suggested a tail trim that drops the last sentence, which brings it to 206.
- **Bluesky — FAIL:** the body contains the blog URL, which is added automatically. I suggested removing it, which leaves 181 characters.
- **LinkedIn — PASS**, with one advisory note: the closing pointer, "The blog post is the expanded version," is generic.

The X and Bluesky counts come from a `len()` check.

I did not run the suggestions sub-agent for LinkedIn. I wrote that one advisory note myself.

The file starts with `<!-- social-review -->`, uses the orienting note, collapses the suggested copy and the advisory note in `<details>`, and ends with the commit footer. I also added the two-line CTA that the CI section of SKILL.md calls for.
